meta.audience: people whose ideas live in scattered notes and who want them to become projects
meta.title: LAYR
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from the app: source/README.md, its design tokens (src/index.css in the app repository), its sample notes and its captured screens. Near-black #0B0B0C with slate and steel metal (#2A2F3A to #9FB0C8), lime #D9F55B only as a point; five layer tones from #E6EBF2 to #434D5E; the glass layer stack and the brand mark drawn from the app's own SVG code.

source.notes: scattered notes become projects: on-device TF-IDF bundles, five layers (배경·문제, 아이디어, 할 일, 참고, 질문), a one-page brief; nothing leaves the browser

the real app (its production build, served locally) captured by capture/app.json: the heads of the three bundles it proposes, the one-page brief it writes, and its state after 모두 수락 (state_*.txt: which note went to which project and layer)
Pretendard Variable (the app's face) and JetBrains Mono (labels); SIL OFL 1.1

rationale.palette: The app's tokens: near-black #0B0B0C / #0E0F11 with surfaces #121317 / #17191E, text #F3F5F8 / #B7BFCB / #8D96A5, steel #9FB0C8 / #C9D3E3 and its metal gradient (#14171D, #2A2F3A, #56637A, #9FB0C8), lime #D9F55B only for the one thing that matters; the project colours #9FB0C8, #E2C69A, #8CCFDB; the five layers from light to dark.
rationale.type: Pretendard Variable at 800 for headlines (the app's hero: 흩어진 메모를 / 층으로 쌓아 프로젝트로.), white on near-black; JetBrains Mono capitals for the app's numbered labels (01 / INBOX, BUNDLE / 01).
rationale.motion: Calm and exact: things settle rather than bounce. Notes drift, then glide into place; the glass plates drop in from the bottom up the way the app's hero does; a low camera and slow parallax. Springs are well damped.
rationale.sound: Dark synth in E minor at 112 BPM (7 bars in 15 s, 14 in 30 s): a soft pulse and plucks under the steel and glass, digital SFX for the drops.
rationale.visuals: Four scenes in the 15 s cut: the name and the app's line beside its glass layer stack, scattered notes falling into it; the sample notes gliding into the three bundles the app proposes (their real heads); one project's ten notes sorted onto five exploded layers; the end card. The 30 s cut adds the one-page brief the app writes.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a short, muted launch reel with slogan-length Korean copy shown as type.
